original: 人だけではなくて、建物や壁が微かに持っている魂魄も感じられます。

en.text: I can feel not only people's souls, but also the faint spirit held by buildings, walls and such.

en.text: The boy faintly resembled his father in appearance.

original: ふと、私は、後ろから聞えて来る微かな跫音に耳を聳てたのです。

en.text: Suddenly, I raised my ears to the faint sound of footsteps coming from behind me.

en.text: The food tasted slightly of garlic.
